'''Ahran Nawaz''' was once a powerful noble in the [[Free Years]].

==History==
In c. {{fy|1096}}, forces led by Lord Ahran Nawaz, Lord [[Jalaam Lazari]], and Lady [[Bastine Almadar]] took the city of [[Bandar Eban]] and declared a nation that would become Arad Doman, and would ally themselves to an informal council of merchants, which would become formalized during the end of the [[War of the Hundred Years]].
